sourceName: APA Division 12 (Society of Clinical Psychology) – Research-Supported Psychological Treatments
notes: Classic Division 12 empirically supported treatments list (primarily adult populations), retrieved from Internet Archive snapshots of div12.org. The society is migrating to a new Tolin-criteria review system; ratings here reflect the classic Chambless criteria (Strong = 2+ rigorous RCTs by independent teams; Modest = at least one good trial). Each record carries its snapshot date.

ratingScale.Modest Research Support: At least one good RCT or several smaller studies
